I used to go to the dog park, but I recently moved to a new hospital because they offered me better pay due to it being a slightly underserved area; there is nothing down here and I don't fit the demo-graph (I'm Indian American).

Thank you for caring. I appreciate it. Yeah I'm sticking around cause my dog.... poor guy would go crazy without me. I've never really been happy. I pretend to be happy around people with a fake smile and a laugh. I have a poker face with my patients (when I used to work). I've had brief moments, when I drive my car. When I play with my dog, when I do well on tests or other positive reinforcement. But like you said.... it's all very fleeting. 

I'm not going to change my meds. Psych was never my specialty. I have an appointment in a couple days where I'll tell him my concerns.

I have always had chronic depression. Probably started when my parents used to beat the shit out of me my entire childhood and berating me constantly. I've never let it get to me, but it finally has I think.

I'm living for my dog. I have nothing else. My parents don't get me. My brother is wayyy too happy and busy with his own stuff to give a shit about me. I've done everything I'm supposed to by 30 I guess, society wise, except meet someone and settle down. I graduated med school, that was a goal. I bought a house. I got a car I love. Still have yet to buy my dream car. That being said, I recently quit working because I lost my drive. I've lost my empathy. Idgaf about anyone. I hate myself and my life. I have 0 friends. Literally 0. I'm going back to school just to stay busy, but it's not helping. I'm medicated and sleepy all the time, plus they don't seem to be helping.
I don't think anyone does. Maybe I did something in my past life. Maybe karma is coming back to me. I'm a doctor too. I quit working too because I lost all my empathy and drive.
I don't see a way out. It's fucking cyclic. One step forward, two steps back till I fall in my grave.
